purpose: Join sampled judge-calibration rows with original questions, compact evidence packs, reference outputs, and predictions so a human or independent judge can adjudicate support decisions without searching run directories.

recommended_fields: human_verdict: supported | partial | unsupported | correct_abstention | incorrect_abstention | invalid
adjudication_schema.instruction: Judge only from the compact evidence pack in each row. Do not use paper knowledge outside the provided evidence.

llm_budget.note: This packet joins local artifacts only.
